title: Jay Bowman
intro:
Jay Bowman (independent) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Kentucky's 6th Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Bowman completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2025. Click here to read the survey answers.
